name: Riving Strike
prerequisites: Arcane Strike, ability to cast arcane spells
benefit:
If you have a weapon that is augmented by your Arcane Strike feat, when you damage a creature with an attack made with that weapon, that creature takes a –2 penalty on saving throws against spells and spell-like abilities. This effect lasts for 1 round.
## Combat Trick (from the Combat Stamina feat)
**Source** Pathfinder Unchained pg. 130
When you use this feat, you can spend up to 3 stamina points to increase the duration of the effect by 1 round for each stamina point spent.
flavor: When you infuse your weapon with arcane might, your attacks make foes more susceptible to magic.
